business.lookup.identityHint: Generated and saved by the platform. Renaming this node does not change these identifiers.
business.lookup.checksHint: Check the combined upstream and returned fields. These checks do not perform anatomical interpretation or call a model.
business.lookup.resultRequired: Result fields that must not be NULL

business.layout.qualityHint: Check whether upstream records can be processed. Business scope is selected in the database query.
business.layout.nullHint: These fields must not be NULL. This check does not reject all empty or whitespace text.
business.layout.enableIdentity: Merge identical records and detect conflicting facts
business.layout.uniqueHint: Any repeated combination is an error here. This differs from identity-based merging of identical records.

business.layout.rangeHint: All conditions must hold (AND). Task parameters use the submitted values; constants define the fixed business scope.
business.layout.tableOutput: Conditions select records, not columns. Matching records retain all table fields and are passed downstream as a saved dataset.

business.layout.conflictHint: Confirmed conflicts prevent acceptance of a classification. Unlike ambiguity hints, model confidence cannot resolve them automatically.
business.layout.modelHint: The model assists when rules are inconclusive or ambiguity is flagged. Evidence requirements still apply; confidence is displayed, not used as an automatic threshold.
business.layout.prefixHint: Changing the result prefix changes output field names. Review downstream references before saving.
business.api.requestHint: Bind each parameter to an upstream field, task parameter or typed constant. GET sends query parameters; POST sends JSON.

business.api.rawOutput: Data: API records; Issues: request or response problems.

business.compare.traceHint: Carry forward the original record identifier for result linkage. This identifier is not a quantity unit.

business.compare.outputHint: Data retains equal, different or unknown results; differences are right minus left.
business.compare.acceptanceHint: Data connects to Results in this flow. Inspect inputs, calculated amounts and comparisons in an existing task dataset; configuration summaries are not execution results.
